Ship the InkOS Projects list page v2 upgrades per audit. Project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS.

**Read first:**
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — brand tokens (Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only), Stack A rules
- [~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md] — antipatterns
- [app/(app)/projects/page.tsx] — current list page server
- [components/projects/ProjectsListClient.tsx] — current list client
- [components/projects/ProjectCard.tsx] — current card render
- [app/globals.css] — tokens

**Database already extended** (Dato Wave 1 completed):
- `projects.status` now has 7 values: `planning | deposit_paid | active | healing | completed | on_hold | cancelled`
- New columns: `size`, `color_mode`, `deposit_apply_rule`, `secondary_artist_ids`, `reference_notes`, `stalled_at`
- New tables: `project_deposit_transactions` (ledger), `project_activity_log`

If `lib/supabase/types.ts` is stale (types not regenerated because Docker unavailable), cast carefully with `as` where needed — but **never `as any`**. Use type assertions on specific narrow types, or declare a local extension type.

### Build

### 1. View toggle — 4 views
Top-right segmented control: **Board** (default) / **List** / **Gallery** / **Timeline**
- Board: new 5-column Kanban (below)
- List: existing list rows (keep current)
- Gallery: existing grid (enhance: each card's cover image fills the whole tile Pinterest-style; the audit calls out current grid shows placeholders — make moodboard the focal visual)
- Timeline: v1.5 placeholder — render a "Coming soon — timeline view will show every project's sessions mapped across next 90 days." card. No actual Gantt in v1.
- Persist user's view choice per-account — write to `studio_members.preferences` JSONB if exists, else `localStorage`
- Icon segmented control with keyboard: `V` then `B/L/G/T` switches

### 2. Board view — 5 lifecycle columns
New component `components/projects/ProjectsBoardView.tsx`:
- Columns: **Planning** · **Deposit Paid** · **Active** · **Healing** · **Complete**
- Each column header: name + count + (+) inline action to create project pre-filled with that status
- Project cards in columns show:
  - Moodboard thumb grid (4-cell): if `cover_photo_url` exists use that, else use first 4 `project_references`, else gradient stand-in (Bone/Stone gradient — no brand-violating colors)
  - Project name
  - Client name + artist name
  - Up to 2 style tags as chips
  - Session progress bar (sessions completed / total planned)
  - Deposit pill: green "$400 in pool" / amber "Pending" / muted "Pool applied" — using the semantic tokens from globals.css (Rust for pending if no warning token exists). **Four-color rule still applies.**
  - Primary artist avatar
- **Drag between columns** using `@dnd-kit/core` (already in the project per exploration). On drop:
  - Planning → Deposit Paid: prompt modal "Request deposit from client? Send Stripe link?" — if confirmed, fire existing deposit-request flow; else just flip status
  - Active → Healing: prompt "Mark final session complete?"
  - Other transitions: confirm and apply
  - All transitions write to `project_activity_log` with `event_type='status_changed'`
- **Stalled warning:** Cards in Planning column with `updated_at` older than 45 days get an amber "Stalled 45d" pill on the card. Use a partial amber token or Stone with Rust dot per brand rules.
- **Complete column condensed:** Show only 2 most recent complete projects + "+ N more complete" link (clicking expands). Keeps the board readable.

### 3. Filter chips (replace current dropdown)
New component `components/projects/ProjectFilters.tsx`:
- Multi-select chips above the list: **Status** · **Artist** · **Style** · **Placement** · **Client**
- Active filters render as removable pills above the board/list
- Sync to URL search params (`?status=planning,active&artist=xxx`) so URLs are shareable and back-button works
- Replaces the current thin "all" dropdown

### 4. Sort control
Dropdown: **Last activity** (default, desc) · **Created date** · **Client name** · **Deposit balance** · **Session count** · **Artist**
- Sync to URL (`?sort=deposit_balance`)

### 5. Quick stats bar
New `components/projects/ProjectsStatsBar.tsx` above filters:
- "12 active · $8,400 in deposit pools · 45% avg completion"
- Compute server-side, pass to client. Active = any status NOT in (`completed`, `cancelled`, `on_hold`). Pool = SUM(deposit_pool_cents - deposit_applied_cents). Avg completion = AVG(sessions_completed / sessions_planned * 100) across active projects.
- Subtle styling — one line, tabular-nums on numbers.

### 6. Bulk actions
When multiple projects selected (checkboxes on cards):
- Toolbar appears (same pattern as Inbox) with: Archive / Change status (dropdown) / Export CSV / Clear selection
- Shift+click range selection

### 7. Sample project preview (empty state)
The existing empty state keeps the "+ Start your first project" primary CTA. **Add a secondary CTA:** "See a sample project" which sets `localStorage['inkos:project-demo']='1'`, reloads, and the page renders a demo "Ravi's Koi Sleeve" project with 5 sessions populated, deposit pool, and photo progression. Show a dismissable banner "Demo data — create a real project to switch." Scaffold demo data in `lib/projects/demo-data.ts`.

### 8. Subtitle + breadcrumb fix
- Subtitle update: from "Multi-session tattoo projects" → "Group multi-session tattoos — sleeves, back pieces, bodysuits — with shared deposit pool and photo progression."
- Remove "Dashboard › Projects" breadcrumb (Projects is top-level). Page title already reads "Projects."

### 9. Keyboard shortcuts
- `P` — New Project (from anywhere on page, opens the new project flow)
- `/` — Focus search input
- `V` then `B`/`L`/`G`/`T` — switch view
- `F` — open filter panel
- `X` — select focused card
- `Shift+X` — multi-select
- `E` — edit selected
- `A` — archive selected (confirm)
- `Esc` — close modal / clear selection
- `?` — shortcut overlay

### Brand constraints (strict)
- Four colors only: Bone / Onyx / Stone / Rust. Read [app/globals.css] first for exact tokens. Map any audit mentions of indigo → `--color-accent` (Rust @ 8%); amber → Stone with Rust-dot or a warning token if one exists; green → find success token or use Stone.
- Instrument Serif only on page title + italic moments. Never labels/data/numbers.
- Tabular-nums on every number.
- `shadow-soft` / `shadow-card` — never default Tailwind shadows.
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log` (use [lib/logger.ts]).
- No hardcoded plan-tier checks.

### Reuse existing patterns
- `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable` — already used in `ReferencesTab.tsx` and `TagsManager.tsx` for drag-reorder
- Server actions pattern from [app/(app)/projects/actions.ts]

### Verification
1. `pnpm typecheck`
2. `pnpm build`
3. Manual: open /projects — Board is default view, 5 columns render, drag between columns with confirm dialog, filter chips work, stats bar computes, empty state shows demo option.

### Out of scope
- Timeline view Gantt (placeholder only)
- Drag-reorder within a column (not in v1)
- Shared link / client-facing public view

Report: files changed, Board view verified with 5 columns, drag behavior confirmed, typecheck/build status, demo data works.

88	  let query = supabase

97	    `)
98	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
99	    .order('updated_at', { ascending: false })
100	
101	  if (filters.status) {
102	    query = query.eq('status', filters.status)
103	  }
104	  if (filters.artistId) {
105	    query = query.eq('primary_artist_id', filters.artistId)
106	  }
107	  if (filters.clientId) {
108	    query = query.eq('client_id', filters.clientId)
109	  }
110	  if (filters.search) {
111	    query = query.ilike('name', `%${filters.search}%`)
112	  }
113	
114	  const { data, error } = await query.limit(100)
115	
116	  if (error) {
117	    logger.error(
118	      { error, studioId, code: error.code, message: error.message, hint: error.hint, details: error.details },
